neighbours.label: the subject right after 'what' in a fronted free relative (what I / what he ... loved), and similar subject heads of a fronted noun phrase
fire: Looking back on those summers, what I remember best is the smell of rain.
My grandfather was a quiet man, and what he valued most was honesty.
After the long trip home, what we needed most was a hot meal.
Ask any teacher and they will say that what they enjoy is the students.
Of all the gifts she received, what she treasured was a small wooden box.
In the end, what you learn from failure matters more than the grade.
The coach admitted that what he feared was a late injury.
For most travellers, what they miss first is their own bed.
quiet: Looking back on those summers, I remember the smell of rain best.
My grandfather was a quiet man who valued honesty above all.
After the long trip home, we needed a hot meal more than anything.
Ask any teacher and they will say they enjoy the students.
Of all the gifts she received, she treasured a small wooden box.
In the end, the lessons of failure matter more than the grade.
The coach admitted that he feared a late injury.
For most travellers, their own bed is the first thing missed.

notes: card: no single token; peaks on ' I', ' he' after 'what', ' of' in 'The title of'. probe: 'what I loved most' 0.87, 'What she wanted' 0.28.
